Struct PlanarYUVLuminanceSource 

Source 
pub struct PlanarYUVLuminanceSource { /* private fields */ }
Expand description

This object extends LuminanceSource around an array of YUV data returned from the camera driver, with the option to crop to a rectangle within the full data. This can be used to exclude superfluous pixels around the perimeter and speed up decoding.

It works for any pixel format where the Y channel is planar and appears first, including YCbCr_420_SP and YCbCr_422_SP.

@author dswitkin@google.com (Daniel Switkin)

fn get_row(&self, y: usize) -> Option<Cow<'_, [u8]>>

Fetches one row of luminance data from the underlying platform’s bitmap. Values range from 0 (black) to 255 (white). Because Java does not have an unsigned byte type, callers will have to bitwise and with 0xff for each value. It is preferable for implementations of this method to only fetch this row rather than the whole image, since no 2D Readers may be installed and getMatrix() may never be called. Read more
